note: Increased damage falloff multiplier at max range from 75% to 85%, increasing the damage at longer ranges

We felt the Pike-556 still remained too strong in close-range encounters despite the previous damage adjustments. With these changes we make the weapon less effective at closer ranges while maintaining its effectiveness at longer ranges

Decreased lunge duration of the secondary attack from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds, resulting in ~1m reduction in distance, from roughly 7m to 6m. The note gives the prior distance as ~7m where 4.0.0 had set it to ~6m.
Decreased the length of the secondary attack's hit sweep by 55cm
These changes should decrease the effective range of the lunge attack by ~1.5m, hopefully making the Sword slightly less oppressive for players facing it.
